groups.name: documented-limitations
groups.description: Behavior listed in bugs.md. These pin today's output so a fix has to change a test on purpose; none of it is desired behavior

cases.desc: date with hyphens gets en dashes
phone number gets an en dash
rub followed by a number is read as a currency code
letter and digit before the unit are read as a number and a temperature
no. followed by a number is read as a numero sign
capital letter before a capitalized word is read as an initial
initial rule also joins across a line break
backslash plus a shortcode name in a Windows path is expanded
a path whose name is not a shortcode is left alone
a path whose name is an emoticon shortcode is expanded
ja: hyphenated phone number gets en dashes
ko: hyphenated phone number gets en dashes
ja: doubled ellipsis character becomes two dot runs
ja: temperature gets a narrow no-break space, convention is none
ko: temperature gets a narrow no-break space, convention is none
apostrophe at the end of an inline piece is read as a closing quote
number absorbed by the currency rule is not multiplied
number absorbed by the temperature rule is not multiplied
operator in its own inline piece is not seen
